description: While slide mode is active, a fenced code block tagged with an unrecognized language that the slide highlighter cannot highlight and that is not a special-cased diagram language is passed through as a plain code element that preserves the language label as a class on the code element. This boundary scenario exercises a differently named unrecognized language while slide mode is active. The input supplies Markdown containing a fenced block in an unrecognized language; output reports whether the language-preserving code marker is present.
